title: Owned the My Accounts revamp through release
summary: I drove the revamp of the exchange's My Accounts area onto the shared data layer, then prioritized and closed the release's last open issues with the US lead.
what_would_have_happened: My Accounts kept its slow, portal-bound data access and its open release issues.
the_call: Move My Accounts onto the shared data layer and fix the slow data access at its source.
what_i_did: Led the port to the data layer, then ranked the release's remaining issues and worked them to closure.
what_changed: Two later reviews recorded a significant performance improvement; the US lead signed off the final issues with 'Awesome!'.
